title: Facet
tagline: Three shots at the same board as everyone else.
description: A ring of mirrored panels, and one beam of light. You drag from the rim to aim, release, and watch it ricochet — every panel it grazes lights up and stays lit. You get three shots to light all sixteen. Everybody in the world plays the same board on the same day, so a result is worth comparing, and there is an unlimited mode with fresh boards when three shots is not enough for one sitting.
author: HexCave
controls: Drag to aim, release to fire
Arrow keys nudge the angle by half a degree
howToPlay: Drag anywhere on the board to aim. The launch point snaps to the nearest point on the rim and a dotted line previews the first bounce.
Release to fire. The beam reflects off panels and the rim until it runs out, lighting every panel it touches.
Panels stay lit between shots, so plan the next shot around what is still dark.
You have three shots on the daily board. Clear it and your streak grows; come back tomorrow for a new one.
Unlimited mode gives you endless fresh boards — clear one to move straight to the next.
goal: Light all sixteen panels in three shots. Fewer shots is better; every board here has been proved clearable.

1.0.0.notes: First release. Daily boards proved clearable through September 2027.
